description:
## Goal

Make `NativeProgram(root)` the sole persistent exact root product. Unchanged requests perform zero native lowering, unreachable edits do no native work, and reached edits lower only the exact invalidated reader closure.

## Combined-head truth

Native lowering still enters through `Job::LowerNativeProgram(root)` and a World projection even though native answers are now immutable shared handles. `NativeProgramMap` shares generic projection machinery after fz-tfn.9, but it remains a second authority until this ticket deletes it.

## Strategy and proof

1. After fz-tfn.1 retains root product sessions and fz-tfn.10 deletes side inventories, define `NativeProgram(root)` as the root product reading exact `RootBackendProduct(root)` content/generation.
2. Route every interp/JIT/AOT front door through that product.
3. Preserve a cache hit for transport-only or equal backend reproduction and canonical pointer identity on unchanged settlement.
4. Prove one compiler/root across unchanged request, unreachable edit, reached-leaf edit, equal reproduction, macro roots, and all three doors; require exact causal work counts.
5. Delete `Job::LowerNativeProgram`, `FactKey::NativeProgram`, `NativeProgramMap`, direct front-door execution, revision/projection plumbing, and bridge-only tests/docs.

## Acceptance

One retained product is the only native-program authority; unchanged and unreachable requests lower zero bodies. No direct job, fact/map mirror, whole-root validation scan, or compatibility path remains. Canonical artifacts/output, exact invalidation, cross-process work, full library/serial matrix, formatting, check, strict clippy, and docs pass.
title: Make NativeProgram a persistent exact root product
